newsitem.title: USA: Endorex offers oral drug delivery system.
newsitem.headline: Endorex offers oral drug delivery system.

text.p: Endorex Corp said Thursday it signed a licensing agreement with the Massachusetts Institute of Technology for a newly developed oral drug delivery system.

Endorex, formerly known as ImmunoTherapeutics, said the patented technology uses polymerized liposomes to administer vaccines or other compounds believed to be unsuitable for oral delivery. The company said it will also form a new subsidiary, Orasomal Technologies, to commercialize the delivery system.
Endorex is a biotechnology company that focuses on development of immunopharmaceuticals to treat cancer.
Its stock closed down 3/32 Thursday at 5/8.
